name: FmActions
description:
The actions of a page, beside its title: the first three as buttons, fewer
when the room is short, down to none, and the others in the ⋯ menu. An
action with `confirm` asks in the panel from below before deleting, from the
button and from the menu alike.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions, the most frequent first: the last ones go in the menu first.

name: FmActiveFilter
description: A chosen filter, above a list: it is removed with the ×.

props.name: label
props.description: The filter, for example «Laura» or «Work and income».

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: What the × says to a screen reader, when it does not remove a filter.

name: FmAgendaFilters
description:
The filters of the *Agenda*: the period (the months the server offers), the
person and the areas. On the computer (`toolbar`) they are a bar above the
list, as the board *Agenda-pc* draws it: the period as a segmented control,
the people as round buttons and, on the right, *All areas*, which opens the
menu of the areas. On the phone (`sheet`) three buttons say what is chosen
(«1 month», «Everyone», «All areas») and each opens the panel from below with
all the filters, which ends with *Show 10 entries*. An area is a button that
turns it off: its name is struck through and its number stays, so the
hidden entries stay counted. The page keeps the filters: the component only
says what the person chose.

*Reminders* has no period: in its place `views` chooses the list (*To do* and
*Done*), a segmented control on the computer and two buttons beside the
others on the phone, which choose without opening the panel; and with
`searchLabel` the toolbar has a search box before the areas.

props.name: variant
props.description: A bar above the list on the computer, buttons and a panel from below on the phone.

props.name: filters
props.description: The filters in use.

props.name: people
props.description: The people of the family.

props.name: areas
props.description: The areas, in order, with the name the server gives them.

props.name: periods
props.description: The periods the person can choose, in months, as the server offers them; none, no period.

props.name: views
props.description: The lists to choose between in place of the period, chosen with `v-model:view`.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: What is searched: with it the toolbar has a search box, filled with `v-model:search`.

props.name: counts
props.description: How many entries each area has for the person chosen, hidden areas too.

props.name: shown
props.description: How many entries the list shows with these filters.

props.name: open
props.description: The panel is open (only for `sheet`).

props.name: view
props.description: The list chosen among `views`.

props.name: search
props.description: The text typed in the search box.

name: FmAgendaRow
description:
An entry of the Agenda, in two layouts. In the Agenda (`agenda`, the
boards *Agenda* and *Agenda-pc*): the day with its weekday (the month, in
red, once passed), the icon of the area, the thing in bold with the state
of its reminder beside it (*Notice on 03/11*, *Reminder done*, *Reminder
late*), below what happens to it, then the person, how far it is
(«tomorrow» highlighted) and the amount («—» for a deadline). With
`actions` a passed deadline has *Update the date* and *Renewed*, outside
the link, when the person may change its date (`update_url`). In the Home (`home`): the dot of the area, the title, below the
card with how far it is («Gas - Enel · in 4 days»), or «Late by 3 days ·
23/10/2026» in red, and the amount, with «~» if it is an estimate. The
whole row leads to the entry.

props.name: entry
props.description: The entry, as the server sends it.

props.name: layout
props.description: The Agenda (the day on the left, the person) or the Home (the dot and the line below).

props.name: personAvatar
props.description: The initials and photo of the person of the entry, from the people of the page; without it the first letter of the name shows.

props.name: actions
props.description: Only in the Agenda: *Update the date* and *Renewed* under the row, for a passed deadline the person may change.

name: FmAlsoDo
description:
The block *What I do too* of the Import page and of the proposal of a file,
as the board *Importa* draws it: a bold heading and, stacked under it, what
the reading creates besides the document (an expense, a payment, a link to
a card), each one an `FmAlsoDoItem` the person can untick or correct. The
page decides which items there are.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading; without it, *What I do too*.

name: FmAlsoDoItem
description:
One thing the reading does besides the document, inside `FmAlsoDo`, as the
board *Importa* draws it: a box with a tick, an optional icon, the text, a
line of explanation and the warnings in orange. The whole row is a label, so
a tap on the text ticks it. While it is ticked the box is blue and shows,
under the row, the fields to correct and the actions (*Choose another…*,
*Create a new …*, *Back to the proposal*).

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the checkbox, already translated.

props.name: hint
props.description: A line of explanation under the text.

props.name: warnings
props.description: What the person should know before leaving it ticked, one line each.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon before the text, from `@lucide/vue`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: It cannot be ticked or unticked.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Whether the item is ticked.

name: FmAmount
description:
An amount of the budget: «84,20 €», an estimate as «~72,00 €», a changed
amount with the old one struck through, an income as «+1.720,00 €» in green.

props.name: amount
props.description: The amount.

props.name: estimated
props.description: The amount is an estimate.

props.name: base
props.description: The amount before an exception changed it; it is shown struck through.

props.name: income
props.description: The amount comes in: a plus and the colour of what is paid.

name: FmAvatar
description: The circle of a person: their photo or, without one, the initials on a colour.

props.name: initials
props.description: The initials, when the photo is missing.

props.name: photo
props.description: The address of the photo.

props.name: name
props.description: The name, for those who cannot see the photo.

props.name: size
props.description: The side of the circle, in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: The class of the background colour of the initials.

name: FmBackLink
description:
The link back to the page a page comes from, with a chevron and that page's
name, above the title or the header of a page.

props.name: href
props.description: The address of the page it comes from.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of that page, the text of the link.

name: FmBarChart
description:
The chart *Expenses, the last 6 months*: for each month a bar with what was
spent and a dark mark where the plan reaches, the month in progress named
and its amount written above. Drawn in SVG, with a legend, a title on each
month for the hover and *See as a table* for those who read the numbers.
The spent is told by the bar and the planned by the mark, so the two are not
told apart by colour alone.

props.name: months
props.description: The months, oldest first.

name: FmBell
description:
The bell in the header of the Home. When there are notices not yet seen it
shows how many in a red dot (up to 99). A tap opens the menu of the notices
under it, on the computer and on the phone, as the board *Avvisi-pc* draws
it: the title *Notices* with *Mark all as read* while something is new,
then the last notices (`FmNoticeList`, at most 10, the server chooses them)
and *See all the notices*, which leads to the page with the search. The notices are not in the page until the
menu asks for them: opening it emits `open`, and until `notices` arrives the
menu says it is loading.

props.name: count
props.description: How many notices the person has not seen yet.

props.name: notices
props.description: The notices of the menu; missing until the page loads them.

name: FmBottomBar
description:
The bottom bar of the phone (below 1024 px): Home, Budget, the + of Upload in
the middle, Areas and More. More opens a panel with Agenda, Documents, Family,
Settings and Log out, and stays marked when one of those pages is open.

props.name: active
props.description: The section of the page that is open.

props.name: items
props.description: The navigation items.

props.name: uploadCount
props.description: The files waiting to be sorted: the number on the +; nothing at zero, 99+ above 99.

name: FmBottomSheet
description:
The panel that rises from the bottom over the darkened page, for short actions
and filters. On the computer it is a window in the middle. It closes with the
handle, with the ×, with Esc and by tapping outside; while it is open the focus
stays inside. With `beforeClose` these ways ask first, as a form with changes
not saved does. Esc in an open menu of a field closes the menu only.

props.name: title
props.description: The title of the panel.

props.name: above
props.description:
Above every other panel, whatever their order in the page: a question
asked while a panel is open («Leave without saving?», «Delete…?»).

props.name: beforeClose
props.description:
Asked before closing with the handle, the ×, Esc or a tap outside: the
panel stays open when it gives false. The buttons of the panel close it
without asking.

props.name: open
props.description: Open or closed.

name: FmButton
description:
The button of the canvas, in five variants. Only one solid button per page:
the one done most often. With `href` it becomes an Inertia link.

props.name: variant
props.description: The look: solid (blue), outline, soft (light blue), text, danger (red).

props.name: type
props.description: The type of the button, when it is not a link.

props.name: href
props.description: The address: if there is one, the button is a link.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled: it cannot be tapped.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon before the text.

props.name: wide
props.description: Full width, like the main button on the phone.

props.name: download
props.description: With `href`: a plain link that downloads the file, not an Inertia visit.

props.name: external
props.description: With `href`: a plain link that opens the address in a new tab.

props.name: label
props.description:
Only the icon, square: this is the text shown on hover and said to screen
readers, and the text of the slot is left out.

props.name: small
props.description: With `label`: a smaller square, 40 px, as beside the title of a panel.

props.name: xsmall
props.description: With `label`: the smallest square, 30 px, as beside the tabs of a card.

props.name: plain
props.description: With `label`: no background until hovered, as beside a row.

name: FmCard
description:
The white card of the pages. With `list` it holds rows (`FmRow`) separated by
a line, without padding inside because the rows have their own, and rows
that come and go are animated. The links of the section go beside the title,
in `actions`, as `FmSectionLink` (or `FmMenu` with `text`). With the tone
`overdue` the title is red with the alert icon and the card has a red ring;
a short explanation can go under the card, in `note`.

props.name: title
props.description: The title of the section, above the content.

props.name: list
props.description: It holds a list of rows.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour of the title and of the ring: `overdue` is red, for what is late.

name: FmCardBudget
description:
The payments on the page of a card, as the boards of the cards draw them:
in the box at the top the oldest open due date (the renewal of a policy, the
next instalment of a loan, the salary coming in), which opens *A due date*
(with *It arrived* open on a salary);
the figures, beside the dates of the card (`tiles`); how far a loan is paid;
the open due dates; then the data of the card (the default slot). The
planned expenses and their payments (`FmCardPayments`) the page shows under
the documents; without a budget only the tiles and the data remain.

props.name: budget
props.description: The payments of the card, null when none is sent.

props.name: card
props.description: The address of the card: its type and its number.

name: FmCardDocumentActions
description:
The buttons beside a document on the page of a card: *Open in a new tab*,
always in sight, and the ⋮ menu with *Edit* (the page of the document, as
its row), *Unlink* and *Delete* (for an `admin`), each after asking. The
page keeps its state, so in the form of the card what is written stays.
In the form (`inForm`) only the menu is left, where the room is short, with
*Open the file* first, and the links open in a new tab, so the form stays;
there *Unlink* asks nothing and sends nothing, the form unlinks when saved.

props.name: document
props.description: The document linked to the card.

props.name: card
props.description: The address of the card in the routes: its type and its number.

props.name: canDelete
props.description: Whether whoever looks may delete the document.

props.name: inForm
props.description: In the form of the card: only the menu, its links in a new tab, and *Unlink* left to the form.

name: FmCardFiles
description:
The documents of a card on grey, beside its form, as the file beside *Edit
the document*: *Link* beside the title, at the top the zone to add files,
then the files chosen and not saved yet, then the documents: those chosen
in *Link*, and those already linked, with the menu of the card page. Every
row opens its file in a new tab, so the form is not left. Nothing is sent
here: the form sends the files with the card, and *Upload* opens to file
them; it links the documents chosen and unlinks those marked when saved,
so until then a choice can be taken back.

props.name: documents
props.description: The documents already linked to the card; none for a new card.

props.name: card
props.description: The address of the card in the routes; none for a new card.

props.name: canDelete
props.description: Whether whoever edits may delete the linked documents.

props.name: errors
props.description: Why the server refused some of the files.

props.name: linkable
props.description: The pages loaded so far of the documents that can be linked, for *Link*.

props.name: linkableNext
props.description: The number of the next page of `linkable`, null at the last one.

props.name: linkableSearch
props.description: The search that `linkable` answers.

props.name: hasLinkable
props.description: At least one document of the family can be linked.

props.name: files
props.description: The files chosen and not saved yet.

props.name: link
props.description: The documents chosen in *Link*, linked when the card is saved.

props.name: unlink
props.description: The ids of the linked documents to unlink when the card is saved.

name: FmCardForm
description:
The form of a card, built from the description the server gives
(`CardFieldData`): each field becomes the FormKit Pro input of its kind, and
a field shows only when its `show_when` holds, for example the vehicle only
for a car policy, and its label can change with `label_when`, for example
the POD code of electricity that is a PDR code for gas. A hidden field is
sent empty. For a loan the page also gives `loanFigures`: under the instalment
the form shows the total to pay and the cost, which it asks the server for
(a partial reload) 300 ms after the amounts or the start stop changing. The same form creates and
edits every type of card: the page gives the fields and the values, and gets
them back with `submit`.

props.name: fields
props.description: The description of the fields, in the order they are shown.

props.name: values
props.description: The values the form starts from, by column.

props.name: serverErrors
props.description: The errors of the server, by column.

props.name: processing
props.description: The form is being sent: the button waits.

props.name: loanFigures
props.description: The total to pay and the cost of a loan: null until the server answers, left out for any other card.

name: FmCardHeader
description:
The coloured top of a card page, as on the board *Scheda*: «Area · Type»,
the name and the line of data. On the right, the `actions` slot holds
*Edit* and the ⋯ menu.

props.name: card
props.description: The card.

props.name: heading
props.description: The line of data below the name, for example «Plate GH 482 TK · Marco».

name: FmCardPayments
description:
The planned expenses (or incomes) of a card and their payments, as the
boards of the cards and the column beside *Edit card* show them: the rows of
the planned items, which open *A planned expense*, with *Add* for an
`admin`; then the payments a page at a time (the server sends one page,
with the addresses of the others for the pager), each leading to its page,
with *Record payment* and the link to all of them, year by year. Without
a planned item it says to create it first, unless the card has no planned
items of its own (a loan makes its instalment by itself). A card that only
has expenses linked to it (a belonging, a maintenance job, a filing, a
health event) offers *Add expense* instead.

props.name: budget
props.description: The payments of the card.

props.name: card
props.description: The address of the card: its type and its number.

name: FmCardRow
description:
A card in a list: the icon of its type in the colour of its area, the name
and below the subtitle or the next date («Inspection · in 75 days», red once
overdue). It leads to the card; a closed card is grey. In *An area* the
amount of an open due date of the next 30 days is on the right, red when late.

props.name: card
props.description: The card, as a row of a list.

name: FmCategoryBar
description:
A row of *By category*: the name, a bar with what was spent, a mark where the
plan reaches, the comment («193,40 € less») and «spent of planned».

props.name: category
props.description: The name of the category.

props.name: spent
props.description: What was spent.

props.name: planned
props.description: What was planned.

props.name: estimated
props.description: The plan is only an estimate.

props.name: lateTitle
props.description: The title of a due date of the category that is late.

props.name: color
props.description: The colour of the category, for example `#e35169`.

name: FmCategoryOption
description:
A category in the open list of a menu, for the `option` slot of a FormKit
autocomplete: the name alone, the subcategories indented under their main
category. Screen readers read the path instead, as the closed field shows it,
so that two «Other» stay different. A choice that is not a category («All»,
«None») shows its label.

props.name: option
props.description: The option of the menu: a category, or a choice such as «All».

name: FmCategoryTree
description:
A level of the tree of the categories, of documents or of expenses: each
category with, on the right, the number of its documents (or what the `after`
slot shows) and, if it has any, the arrow that opens the subcategories. It
calls itself for the levels below.

props.name: categories
props.description: The categories of this level.

props.name: level
props.description: How deep this level is: 0 for the main ones.

props.name: selectable
props.description: The categories are tapped to choose them (to edit them).

props.name: mainOnly
props.description: Only the main categories are tapped: the subcategories are just read.

name: FmChangeDeadlineSheet
description:
*Change this due date*: the panel that changes one due date and not the
planned expense. Three choices, more than one at a time: it is skipped
(which turns the other two off), it has another amount, it has another
date; and a note. It sends them to `action` as the server reads them.

props.name: deadline
props.description: The due date to change.

props.name: action
props.description: Where the changes are sent (PUT).

props.name: open
props.description: The panel is open.

name: FmChecklist
description:
*To begin*, on the Home of a new family: the first steps, each a link to
where it is done. A step done has the green tick and its text struck through.
The page decides which steps there are and when each is done.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order.

name: FmConfirm
description:
The panel from below that asks again before an action that is easy to do by
mistake: the question, what happens, *Cancel* and the button that confirms.
It sits above the other panels, also when it is asked from one of them.
`FmConfirmDelete` uses it to delete; the form of a document, to remove a
saved link.

props.name: question
props.description: The title of the panel, for example «Delete this document?».

props.name: text
props.description: What happens, under the title.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The text of the button that confirms.

props.name: open
props.description: Open or closed.

name: FmConfirmDelete
description:
The panel from below that asks again before deleting: the question, what
happens, *Cancel* and the button that deletes. Opened by *Delete*, as a
button (`FmDeleteButton`) or as an entry of a menu.

props.name: url
props.description: The address the deletion is sent to.

props.name: question
props.description: The title of the panel, for example «Delete this document?».

props.name: text
props.description: What happens, under the title.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The text of the button that deletes.

props.name: preserveState
props.description: The page stays as it is, as a form with what is written and not saved.

props.name: open
props.description: Open or closed.

name: FmDateTile
description:
A date of a card on its page: the label, the date as `15/10/2026` and below
how far it is from today. An expiring date already passed reads «Expired 3
days ago» in red.

props.name: date
props.description: The date, with its label and whether it expires.

name: FmDeadlineDateSheet
description:
The panel of a passed deadline in the Agenda: *Update the date* corrects
the date written on the card, *Renewed* writes the new one (proposed a year
later) and marks the reminder of the old date done. It sends the date to the
`update_url` of the entry.

props.name: entry
props.description: The passed deadline; it has an `update_url`.

props.name: renewed
props.description: It was renewed: the new date is proposed a year later and the reminder is marked done.

props.name: open
props.description: The panel is open.

name: FmDeadlineRow
description:
A due date in a list: the dot of the area, the title, the card it belongs to
with its day (red when late) and on the right the amount. It leads to *A due
date*.

props.name: deadline
props.description: The due date.

props.name: href
props.description: *A due date*, where the row leads.

name: FmDeleteButton
description:
*Delete*, red, which asks again in the panel from below before deleting:
the question, what happens, *Cancel* and the button that deletes.

props.name: url
props.description: The address the deletion is sent to.

props.name: question
props.description: The title of the panel, for example «Delete this document?».

props.name: text
props.description: What happens, under the title.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The text of the button that deletes.

props.name: compact
props.description: Only the bin, without the text, as in the panel beside the list.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the button, when it is not *Delete*: «Delete the copy».

name: FmDocumentActions
description:
The buttons of a document. On its own page they are `FmActions`: *Download*,
*Edit* (light blue) and *Delete* (red, for an `admin`, after asking) as
buttons while they fit, and *Open in a new tab* and *Share* in the ⋯ menu.
In the panel beside the list *Download* is an icon and the rest is in the
menu.

props.name: document
props.description: The document.

props.name: compact
props.description: The panel beside the list: *Download* as an icon, *Edit* in the menu.

name: FmDocumentDetail
description:
A document as the board *Un documento* shows it: the preview of the file on
grey and, beside it, its data, the linked records (one type at a time) and
the notes. On its own page the buttons are next to the title of the page; in
the panel beside the list it is one card, with the title, the date and the
buttons (`FmDocumentActions`) on top.
Used by *A document* and, on the computer, on the right of *Documents*.

props.name: document
props.description: The document.

props.name: compact
props.description:
The panel beside the list: one card, with the title and the date on top
and, on their right, *Download* and the ⋯ menu, icons only.

name: FmDocumentFilters
description:
The filters of *Documents*: category, person, organization, status and the
expiring ones. Every change is sent at once; the page reloads the list. The
category, the person and the organization are found by typing.

props.name: filters
props.description: The filters in use.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices of the menus.

name: FmDocumentForm
description:
The form of a document, as the boards *Proposta* and *Modifica documento*:
what it is, what kind and whose, who it is from, the dates, the status, the
tags, the notes and the records it links to. The same in
*Upload* and in *Edit a document*: the page gives the route and the values.
The category, the person and the organization are found by typing.

props.name: action
props.description:
Where the form is sent: a new document or a change. Without it the form has no buttons and sends
nothing: it only tells its values (`change`), for a page that sends many documents together.

props.name: initial
props.description: The values the form starts from.

props.name: extra
props.description: Data sent with the fields, for example the `file_id` of a new document.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices of the menus.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: The text of the button that sends; with an `action`.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The text of the button that gives up, if there is one.

props.name: proposal
props.description: What the reading found, as form values: written into the fields the person has not touched.

props.name: fill
props.description: Which fields the proposal may write: the ones not touched, or only the empty ones.

props.name: proposalIsStart
props.description: The form opens with the proposal: what it fills in is the start, not a change not saved (a page that shows the reading as already chosen).

props.name: errors
props.description: Errors found outside the form (a page that sent many documents), by field: `title`, `tags.0`…

name: FmDocumentRow
description:
A document in a list: the icon of the file, the title, what it is and whose,
and on the right its date (or its expiry). With `expiry` the line below is
the expiry instead, red once passed and orange while it is ahead, as at the
top of *A person*.

props.name: document
props.description: The document.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the row leads; without it the row is not a link.

props.name: external
props.description: With `href`: the row opens the address in a new tab.

props.name: expiry
props.description: The line below is the expiry, with its colour.

props.name: dateless
props.description: No date on the right, nor the arrow, where the room is short.

props.name: today
props.description: The date of today, ISO: tells a passed expiry from one ahead.

props.name: current
props.description: The document is the one open beside the list.

name: FmEmpty
description:
The card of a page or of a list still empty: an icon, what is missing and,
below, what can be done.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon at the top.

props.name: title
props.description: What is missing.

props.name: text
props.description: The reason, or what will happen.

name: FmFaces
description:
The faces of the family, one over the other: the circles with the initials,
as in the *Invitation accepted* board.

props.name: people
props.description: The people to show.

props.name: size
props.description: The side of each circle, in pixels.

name: FmFamilyViews
description:
The top of *People* and *Organizations*: the title *Family* with the name of
the family, the actions of the page and the two views, each with how many.

props.name: family
props.description: The family, with how many people and organizations it has.

props.name: current
props.description: The view open.

name: FmFileDrop
description:
The zone where the files of documents are dragged or chosen (PDF, JPG, PNG,
HEIC, up to 25 MB each). It does not send them: it gives them to the page,
which uploads them (*Upload*) or keeps them for later (*New card*).

props.name: label
props.default: trans("Drag the files here, or choose them")
props.description: What the zone asks for.

props.name: compact
props.description: A small zone, below a form, instead of the large one of an empty page.

props.name: processing
props.description: The files are being sent: the zone says so.

name: FmFilePanel
description:
The file of a document on grey, as the boards *Un documento* and *Modifica
documento* show it, with the proportions of an A4 sheet: the preview and,
under it, the name of the file. Used by the page of a document, by its panel
beside the list and by *Edit*, where *Change the file* follows the name.

props.name: file
props.description: The file.

props.name: compact
props.description: Smaller corners and padding, inside the card of the panel.

props.name: changeUrl
props.description: Where the new file goes: with it, *Change the file* follows the name.

name: FmFilePreview
description:
The preview of a file: the image the server made of it (a PDF, a HEIC
photo), an image as it is, and the placeholder for the files without a
preview or whose image does not load. The image and the placeholder open
the file in another tab.

props.name: url
props.description: The address that opens the file.

props.name: mimeType
props.description: The real type of the file.

props.name: name
props.description: The original name.

props.name: previewUrl
props.description: The address of the preview image made by the server, `null` when the file has none.

props.name: fill
props.description: Takes the height of the box around it instead of a fixed one.

name: FmFileTile
description:
The small sheet that stands for a file in front of its row: a document of
the family, or a file chosen and not saved yet.

name: FmFold
description:
A folded part of a page, such as the closed cards or the planned expenses
that ended: a button with its title and, when opened, the content in a card
of rows.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the button, for example «Closed (2)».

name: FmHeader
description:
The big title of a sign-in page written by the page itself, when it depends
on the data («Hi, Rosa»): like the one of `AuthLayout`.

props.name: title
props.description: The title.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The sentence below.

name: FmIcon
description:
A Lucide icon with the sizes of the canvas: stroke 2, rounded, 24 px.
Without a label it is only decoration and screen reader users do not hear it.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon, imported from `@lucide/vue`.

props.name: size
props.description: The side in pixels.

props.name: stroke
props.description: The width of the stroke.

props.name: label
props.description: What the icon says, when there is no text next to it.

name: FmImagePanel
description:
The photo of a person or the logo of an organization on grey, beside its
form, as the file beside *Edit the document*. Under it *Add* or *Change*
opens the picker and *Remove* takes it away. Nothing is sent here: the
chosen file and the removal go to the form, which saves them with the rest.
What to draw is up to the default slot, which gets the image to show.

props.name: image
props.description: The address of the saved image, or null without one.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: The button without an image, for example «Add a photo».

props.name: changeLabel
props.description: The button with an image, for example «Change the photo».

props.name: error
props.description: The error of the image, from the server.

props.name: file
props.description: The image chosen and not saved yet.

props.name: removed
props.description: The saved image is to be removed.

name: FmLinkDocumentSheet
description:
*Link a document*: the panel with the documents of the family that can be
linked to a card, searched while typing, 15 at a time with the next ones
loaded at the end of the list, each with ↗ to open it in a new tab. It
only says which document was chosen: the page of the card links it at
once, its form when it is saved. Its props come from the page and are
reloaded without the rest of it, keeping the address.

props.name: linkable
props.description: The pages loaded so far of the documents that can be linked and match the search.

props.name: linkableNext
props.description: The number of the next page of `linkable`, null at the last one.

props.name: linkableSearch
props.description: The search that `linkable` answers.

props.name: hidden
props.description: The ids of the documents not to offer, as already chosen.

props.name: open
props.description: The panel is open.

name: FmLinkedRecords
description:
*Links* of *A person* and *An organization*: the records that name them, one
type at a time, with a tab for each type and how many records it has. With
`reminders` a last entry, *Reminders* with their number, leads to the list of
reminders of that person.

props.name: groups
props.description: The records, grouped by type.

props.name: reminders
props.description: The open reminders of the person: how many, and the list they are in; no entry when missing.

name: FmLoanFigures
description:
The total to pay and the cost of a loan under its instalment in the form,
as the server works them out from what is written so far. A figure that
cannot be worked out yet is a dash.

props.name: figures
props.description: The figures from the server, or null until they come.

name: FmLogo
description:
The Family Manager logo: the roof and the family, white (`on-hero`, white in
both themes) on the light blue square (`brand`).
The white version, without the square, goes on the blue panel of the sign-in pages.

props.name: size
props.description: The side in pixels.

props.name: white
props.description: Only the white drawing, without the square.

name: FmMenu
description:
The ⋯ button that opens a small menu of the less frequent actions, so that
a title next to it keeps its room. The entries are `FmMenuItem`. With
`text` or `outline` the button shows its label beside the icon, as
*Record payment* beside a title or *Postpone* on a late reminder.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the button for screen readers; «More actions» if missing.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon of the button; the ⋯ if missing.

props.name: small
props.description: The smaller ⋯ button, 40 px, as beside the title of a panel.

props.name: plain
props.description: The ⋯ button without a background until hovered, as the plain buttons beside a row.

props.name: text
props.description: The label beside the icon, as the link beside a title (`FmSectionLink`), as *Record payment*.

props.name: outline
props.description: The label beside the icon, in a white button with a grey border, as *Postpone* of a late reminder.

name: FmMenuItem
description:
An entry of `FmMenu`: an action, a page of the app (`href`), an address
opened in a new tab (`href` and `external`) or a file to download (`href`
and `download`).

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon before the text.

props.name: href
props.description: The address: if there is one, the entry is a link.

props.name: external
props.description: With `href`: a plain link that opens the address in a new tab.

props.name: download
props.description: With `href`: a plain link that downloads the file.

props.name: danger
props.description: Red, for the entry that deletes.

name: FmMonthSwitch
description:
The month chosen, with ‹ and › to go to the one before and after. The month
is written in the language of the page.

props.name: month
props.description: The month, `yyyy-mm`.

name: FmMovementPanel
description:
The panel of a movement, as the board *Pagamenti-pc* draws it: the title,
when it was paid (or received) and how much, the commission and the account,
the category and (for an expense) the card of its type, the organization,
the holder, the planned expense or income it
settles (and which of its due dates), and the documents linked to it, with
*Delete*, *Cancel* and *Save*. Without a movement it is the form of a new
expense or income, which starts with the choice between the two. Choosing a
planned expense or income, or a card (also the one *Add expense* of a card
starts with), fills the fields still empty from it. Used beside
the list on the computer (`compact`) and on its own page on the phone.

props.name: movement
props.description: The movement to show and change, or null for a new expense or income.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices of the menus.

props.name: start
props.description: What a new movement starts from: the kind, the planned item and the day.

props.name: occurrences
props.description: The due dates of the planned item that the movement can settle.

props.name: compact
props.description: Beside the list on the computer: it has the × to close it.

name: FmNewTabLink
description:
A link that opens its address in a new tab, with the ↗ icon beside the
text: the person, the organization or the card a card names, so the card
stays open behind.

props.name: href
props.description: The address to open.

props.name: text
props.description: The text of the link, for example «Studio Ferri».

name: FmNotice
description:
A message inside the page, with its icon: some information, something done
(green), something that needs attention (orange) or that is late (red). It
can have a bold title above the text and, on the right, an action (a link or
a button), as the notices at the top of a card. The danger tone is announced
at once (`alert`), the others politely (`status`).

props.name: tone
props.description: Information, done, warning or danger.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon other than the one of the tone.

props.name: title
props.description: A line in bold above the text.

name: FmNoticeList
description:
The notices of the bell: the ones not seen yet in the box *New notices*,
then the ones already seen, each an `FmNoticeRow`; with no notice at all, a
word that they arrive here. It ends saying the same notices arrive by email,
with the way to *Settings*; what the page adds (its pages) goes before
that line. Used by the page *Notices* and by the menu of
the bell (`FmBell`), which put their title above it.

props.name: unread
props.description: The notices the person has not seen yet, the most recent first.

props.name: seen
props.description: The notices already seen, the most recent first.

name: FmNoticeRow
description:
A notice of the bell in *Notices*: the icon with the colour of the area (grey
once seen), what is due, the line of the deadline as the notice said it, when
it went out and, if the reminder is late or done today, a label. A dot marks
a notice not yet seen. The whole row leads to the card or to *Reminders*: a
new notice does so with one POST to `readHref`, which marks it seen and
sends the person on; a seen one is a plain link.

props.name: notice
props.description: The notice, as the server sends it.

props.name: readHref
props.description: Where a new notice is posted to be marked as seen; the server then redirects to the notice's `href`.

name: FmNotificationRule
description:
One notice of a group, as a row of the form of *Settings → Notices*: how
many days, when (before, on the day, after), where it arrives, to whom, and
*Remove this notice*. «Everyone» and the people exclude each other. The row
edits its rule through `v-model`, and `remove` asks the form to drop it.

props.name: people
props.description: The people with an account, for «To whom».

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The notice being edited.

name: FmNumberTile
description:
A figure of the payments of a card, as a tile beside its dates: the label,
the amount (or the number, as *Utilities 4*) and the line below, where the
page writes the amount the server names with `:amount`.

props.name: number
props.description: The figure.

name: FmOrganizationMark
description:
The mark of an organization: its logo or, without one, the icon of its
type. The size, the corners and the background come from the `class` of
whoever uses it, so the list and the page keep their own.

props.name: types
props.description: The values of its types, for the icon.

props.name: logo
props.description: The address of the logo.

props.name: name
props.description: The name, for those who cannot see the logo.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: The side of the icon, in pixels.

name: FmPager
description:
*Previous* and *Next* under a list shown a page at a time (the documents,
the documents of a card); nothing when the list fits in one page.

props.name: previous
props.description: The address of the previous page, null on the first.

props.name: next
props.description: The address of the next page, null on the last.

props.name: preserveScroll
props.description: Keeps the scroll where it is, for a list inside a longer page.

name: FmPasswordField
description:
The password field with the eye to see it, as in the sign-in boards.
It is a `<FormKit>`: it takes the classes of the fields from `formkit.config.ts`.

props.name: label
props.description: The text above the field.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the field in the form.

props.name: help
props.description: The hint below the field, for example «At least 10 characters».

props.name: errors
props.description: The errors that come from the server.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: The hint for the browser: `current-password` or `new-password`.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The password written.

name: FmPayButton
description:
*Record payment* (or *Record income*) of a card: it opens *A due date* with
the panel of *I paid it* on the oldest open due date. With several planned
items it first asks which one, in a menu; without an open due date it is
not there.

props.name: deadlines
props.description: The oldest open due date of each planned item.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the button, for example «Record payment».

name: FmPaySheet
description:
*I paid it* (for an income *It arrived*): the panel that records the payment
of a due date. It asks when, how much and with what, starting from today,
from the amount and from the account of the due date, and takes a receipt if
the person has one. For an income it also says what was expected and what
the income will be called. It sends the form to `action`; the page then
shows the due date as paid. On the phone it rises from the bottom.

props.name: deadline
props.description: The due date to settle.

props.name: accounts
props.description: The accounts of the family to choose from.

props.name: action
props.description: Where the payment is sent (POST).

props.name: open
props.description: The panel is open.

name: FmPaymentYears
description:
The payments of the planned items of a page by year, the latest first: a
line with the year (and, with `counts`, how many payments) and its total,
then each payment with its day, title, account, the clip of a receipt and
the amount. *A planned expense* and the cards list them; on a card a page
of them, on *Payments of a card* every year, the older ones folded with the
whole dates; on both each payment leads to its page.

props.name: years
props.description: The payments by year, the latest year first.

props.name: counts
props.description: The words of the number of payments of each year, for example «9 bills».

props.name: folded
props.description: The years after the first are folded, and their line opens them.

props.name: linked
props.description: Each payment leads to its page.

props.name: fullDate
props.description: Each payment shows the whole date, with the year.

name: FmPlannedRow
description:
A planned expense or income in a list: the icon of its category, the name
with the card and how it repeats below, who it is for, the next due date with
the account, and the amount. It leads to *A planned expense*.

props.name: row
props.description: The planned expense or income.

props.name: href
props.description: *A planned expense*, where the row leads.

name: FmPostponeSheet
description:
*Choose a date…* of *Postpone*: the panel that moves a reminder to a day the
person picks, proposed tomorrow. The day must come after today; the message
of the server shows under it otherwise.

props.name: reminder
props.description: The reminder to postpone.

props.name: open
props.description: The panel is open.

name: FmReadingNotice
description:
What the reading of a file says once it ended: when it is done, the sentence of what was found with the
invitation to check it; when it failed, is off or was skipped, the reason, with *Read again* beside when the page
offers it and asking again can help (failed or off). Nothing while the file waits or was never read.

props.name: status
props.description: Where the reading stands.

props.name: headline
props.description: What the reading found, in a sentence; shown when it is done.

props.name: error
props.description: Why the file was not read; shown when it failed (with a sentence of its own when missing), is off or was skipped.

props.name: again
props.description: True when the page can put the reading back in the queue: *Read again* shows for a reading failed or off.

name: FmReadingProgress
description:
The wait while a file is read: a line that runs, «Reading the document…», a
note that it takes a few seconds and, on the computer, the name of the file
with its pages and the lines found so far (who it is from, the amount…).
Used on the page of the reading and on the rows of the files being read.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the file.

props.name: pages
props.description: The pages of the file; missing when they are not known (a PDF not counted yet).

props.name: found
props.description: What the reading found so far, one line each.

name: FmReminderGroup
description:
The box of a group of notices in *Settings → Notices*: its name (with the
label *Default* for the group of everything else), the kinds of deadline it
covers in words and a line for each notice («45 days before · App and email ·
Everyone»). Whoever can edit has the *Edit* button.

props.name: group
props.description: The group.

props.name: people
props.description: The people with an account, to name the recipients.

props.name: canEdit
props.description: Whoever is looking can edit the group (an `admin`).

name: FmReminderRow
description:
A reminder in the list of *Reminders*, as the boards *Promemoria* and
*Promemoria-pc* draw it: the icon of the area, what to do (a link), below
the thing it refers to (or *Written by hand* for a reminder about nothing)
and «From the deadline of 20/10» when it was postponed, who takes care of it
(*Everyone* without a person), the day with its weekday («Wed 04/11», the
whole date in red once late) and how far it is, the next notice, and the
actions: *Postpone* on a late reminder, the ⋯ menu on the others (postpone,
*Edit*, *Open the card*, *Delete*), and the switch *Done*. A reminder that
is done has *Reopen* instead. On a wide list the parts are columns; on a
narrow one (the phone, or the list beside the form of a reminder) the day
goes on the right of the title and the notice and the actions below.

props.name: reminder
props.description: The reminder, as the list shows it.

props.name: pending
props.description: The server is marking it done: the switch stays on meanwhile.

name: FmRow
description:
A list row of the canvas: in front the dot of the area or an icon, then the
title and the subtitle, each on one line (the title cut in the middle, so
its end shows), on the right an amount or a date. With `href` the whole
row is a link (with `external`, a plain link that opens in a new tab), and
with nothing on the right it shows the arrow. With `button` it is a button,
for the rows that open a panel.

props.name: title
props.description: The main text.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The second line: when, or why it needs attention.

props.name: href
props.description: The address the row opens.

props.name: external
props.description: With `href`: a plain link that opens the address in a new tab.

props.name: area
props.description: The area, for the coloured dot in front.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour of the subtitle.

props.name: button
props.description: The row is a button: it sends `click`.

props.name: current
props.description: The row is the one open now, as the document shown beside the list.

props.name: arrow
props.description: The arrow of a link with nothing on the right; off where buttons follow.

props.name: done
props.description: The thing the row names is done: the title is struck through and soft.

name: FmSearchField
description:
The search box with the magnifying glass: in *Documents*, in the panel that
links a document to a card and, `small`, in the toolbar of *Reminders*. What
it does with the text is up to the page.

props.name: label
props.description: What is searched: the name of the box and the text shown while it is empty.

props.name: small
props.description: As high as the buttons of a toolbar, 36 px, with a smaller text.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The text typed.

name: FmSectionLink
description:
The link beside the title of a section (`FmCard`), as *Upload*, *Add* or
*Record payment*: blue text with its icon, normal weight, no box around it,
underlined on hover. With `href` it is an Inertia link, otherwise a button.
Every section uses it, so the links beside the titles look the same on
every page.

props.name: href
props.description: The address: if there is one, it is a link.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon before the text.

name: FmSidebar
description:
The sidebar of the computer (from 1024 px): the logo and the family, Upload
(with a part on the right that goes to *To sort* while files wait there,
and a tooltip on each that says what it does),
the sections with the areas under *Areas*, and at the bottom *My account*,
which opens Settings and Log out.

props.name: active
props.description: The section of the page that is open.

props.name: path
props.description: The path of the page, for example `/areas/home`, to mark its area.

props.name: items
props.description: The navigation items.

props.name: areas
props.description: The areas with their active cards, in order.

props.name: family
props.description: The name of the family, for example «Bianchi».

props.name: user
props.description: The name of who is signed in.

props.name: uploadCount
props.description: The files waiting to be sorted: the number on the part of *Upload* that goes to *To sort*; nothing at zero, 99+ above 99.

name: FmTabs
description:
The tabs at the top of a set of pages (the three of the budget, *Deadlines*
and *Reminders* of the Agenda). The page lists its tabs; the one of the open
page is marked, and a tab can show a number after its name, and one with nothing behind it can be shown soft and without a link (`disabled`). They are lines
under the names (`underline`) or, as in the Agenda, a grey pill with the open
tab in white (`pill`).

props.name: tabs
props.description: The tabs, in order.

props.name: label
props.description: What the set of tabs is, for those who cannot see it: «Budget».

props.name: variant
props.description: `underline` (the default) or `pill`, a grey strip with the open tab in white.

name: FmTitle
description:
The title at the top of a page: 28 px on the phone, 32 px on the computer, with
the sentence below and, on the right and centred on them, the actions of the
page. Above it, the link back to the page it comes from, with that page's
name, always 20 px above the title like on the pages of a person and an
organization.

props.name: title
props.description: The title of the page.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The sentence below the title.

props.name: back
props.description: The address of the page it comes from.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: The name of the page it comes from, the text of the link back.

name: FmToSortLink
description:
The link to *To sort* that sits beside the title of *Documents* and
*Upload*: a soft button that says how many files wait there. With none it is
not shown.

props.name: count
props.description: How many files wait, copies left out.

name: FmTooltip
description:
A short text that says what an element does, in a dark bubble beside it:
it opens under the mouse after a moment, or when the element is reached with
Tab, and goes away with Escape. The phone has no mouse, so it is only for
hints the computer adds: nothing the person needs on the phone goes here.
Its slot is the element, which keeps its own role and name.

props.name: text
props.description: What the element does, for example «Upload a document from the computer».

props.name: side
props.description: The side of the element where the bubble opens.

name: FmTotal
description:
The blue box of the Home, *To pay in the next 30 days*: the sum of the
payments not yet made, and below how many they are, with the late ones
(«8 payments, one already late»). With nothing to pay it says that nothing
is due and how to begin.

props.name: total
props.description: The sum of the payments, in euros.

props.name: payments
props.description: How many payments make the sum.

props.name: late
props.description: How many of them are already late.

name: FmUploadSheet
description:
*Upload* of a card: the panel with the zone where the files of documents
are dragged or chosen. They are sent at once, linked to the card, and
*Upload* opens with the form of the first one; a file refused leaves the
panel open, with the reason.

props.name: link
props.description: The card the files are linked to.

props.name: open
props.description: The panel is open.

name: FmValueList

props.name: values
props.description: The lines.

props.name: newTab
props.description: A link opens in a new tab.
